scripts.api:generate: npm run backend:openapi:export && python -X utf8 scripts/enrich-openapi-schemas.py && npm --prefix frontend run api:generate && node scripts/trim-generated-api.mjs
scripts.api:check: npm run api:generate && git diff --exit-code -- frontend/src/shared/api/generated
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix frontend exec -- prettier --check package.json frontend/orval.config.ts .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/dependabot.yml scripts/*.mjs
scripts.verify:frontend: npm run frontend:lint && npm run frontend:typecheck && npm run frontend:test && npm run frontend:build
scripts.verify:quick: npm run verify:toolchain && npm run verify:config && npm run format:check && npm run verify:frontend && npm run backend:test:unit
scripts.verify: npm run verify:toolchain && npm run verify:config && npm run format:check && npm run verify:frontend && npm run frontend:audit && npm run backend:verify
